note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. `isCriticalResult` covers only a reported-critical overall status or a very high AFP/beta-hCG germ-cell pattern — a markedly elevated marker with a stable (not rising) trend still classifies abnormal and grades moderate severity via `hasActionSignal`, but never reaches the critical pathway. ALIGNED 2026-09-06 (per the user's explicit decision): `deriveRecommendation` used to map moderate severity to 'urgent-review', unlike every sibling *-test-result engine (which maps moderate — and inconclusive — to that engine's own 'repeat/re-test' recommendation, e.g. further-testing/further-imaging/further-monitoring). Aligned to this engine's own equivalent term, 'repeat-marker' (already used for the inconclusive case), so moderate is no longer MORE alarming than major. The second persona below (moderate severity, followUpUrgency independently 'urgent' via the action-signal rule) now recommends 'repeat-marker' rather than 'urgent-review'; the third persona (major severity, critical-alert) is unaffected.

personas.name: abnormal-stable-elevated-ca125-moderate-not-critical-complete
personas.description: On-treatment CA125 monitoring for known stage III epithelial ovarian cancer shows a markedly elevated but stable value (420 IU/mL, essentially unchanged from 410 IU/mL 4 weeks ago): `hasActionSignal` (markedlyElevated OR a rising trend) classifies abnormal and grades moderate severity regardless of the trend, but `isCriticalResult` requires a reported-critical status or a germ-cell AFP/beta-hCG pattern — neither applies here, since the trend is stable, not rising — so this never reaches critical-alert; report complete — expect abnormal classification + moderate severity (reportingCategory markedly-elevated) + 100% completeness + urgent follow-up + repeat-marker (aligned 2026-09-06 with every sibling *-test-result engine; was 'urgent-review' before the fix, which made moderate severity read as more alarming than major).

state.clinicalHistory: Known stage III epithelial ovarian cancer on maintenance chemotherapy; routine on-treatment CA125 monitoring.
state.comparisonWithPrevious: Comparable to the previous CA125 of 410 IU/mL measured 4 weeks ago; broadly stable, both markedly elevated above the upper reference limit (35 IU/mL).
state.findingsNarrative: CA125 markedly elevated at 420 IU/mL (reference <35 IU/mL), essentially unchanged from the previous value of 410 IU/mL 4 weeks ago.
state.impression: Markedly elevated but stable CA125, consistent with known ovarian cancer disease burden; no evidence of biochemical progression on this value alone.
state.recommendedFollowUp: Continue routine on-treatment CA125 monitoring per the oncology surveillance schedule; correlate with imaging.

expected.recommendedAction: Arrange urgent oncology review and correlate with clinical context.
